acceptanceCriteria: internal/doccorpus, internal/companionrelease and conformance/release-artifact-v0 tests read committed content from a disposable fixture repository instead of the enclosing checkout, with existing assertions preserved.
corvint affected with an unrelated dirty path no longer selects each fixed package through UNBOUNDED_READER, retained in a build-log entry with the measured per-merge saving.
body: Found 2026-10-01 while re-attributing the AFP-V0-023 16-merge replay (V1-0246). These root-locating test packages run git against the real checkout (for example doccorpus TestCorpusSelfDocumentation), so the AFP-V0-023 Landlock wrapper, which denies .git, cannot confine them and they stay on the unbounded-reader floor for every change (doccorpus about 168 package-seconds per merge). PR https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/449 shows the fix pattern for internal/behaviorfalsify: commit synthetic copies of the needed paths to a t.TempDir() repository with an isolated git environment. Expected: each package selected only by its own sources and dependencies. Actual: selected on every dirty path.
title: tests: give doccorpus, companionrelease and release-artifact-v0 hermetic git fixtures so they leave the affected floor
